nodes.name: .vscode-test.mjs
nodes.summary: This file configures VS Code extension tests using the @vscode/test-cli package, defining test file patterns, Mocha options, workspace folder, and launch arguments.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Configures Playwright for end-to-end testing of VS Code, setting CI-aware timeouts, retries, and a two-project test pipeline.

nodes.name: test-setup.js
nodes.summary: Configures TypeScript path aliases for test execution by mapping 'src' to 'out/src' and mocks the '@google/genai' module to avoid ESM compatibility issues.

nodes.name: esbuild.mjs
nodes.summary: This ESBuild configuration script builds a VS Code extension with support for production, watch, standalone, and e2e modes, including custom alias resolution and WASM file copying.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Determines the build config based on flags, then builds or watches the project.

nodes.name: api-secrets-parser.mjs
nodes.summary: Parses the ApiHandlerSecrets TypeScript interface from api.ts to automatically discover API key fields for all providers, eliminating manual maintenance of provider-to-API-key mappings.

nodes.name: parseApiHandlerSecrets
nodes.summary: Extracts field definitions from the ApiHandlerSecrets interface using regex and returns a map of field names to metadata.

nodes.name: mapProviderToApiKeys
nodes.summary: Maps provider IDs to required API key fields by matching field names to provider patterns and applying special-case mappings.

nodes.name: extractProviderFromFieldName
nodes.summary: Determines the provider ID from an API key field name using pattern matching and normalization.

nodes.name: normalizeProviderName
nodes.summary: Converts a camelCase provider part to a kebab-case provider ID, handling special cases.

nodes.name: applySpecialCaseMappings
nodes.summary: Applies special-case field mappings for providers like Bedrock and SAP AI Core that require multiple fields.

nodes.name: generateApiKeyDisplayName
nodes.summary: Generates a human-readable display name from a camelCase or special field name.

nodes.name: validateApiKeyMappings
nodes.summary: Validates that all providers have at least one API key field mapped and returns warnings for unmapped providers.

nodes.name: build-tests.js
nodes.summary: This script builds test source files using esbuild with optional watch mode and compiles TypeScript with a separate test configuration.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Creates an esbuild context for the test source configuration and either watches for changes or rebuilds and disposes of the context.

nodes.name: build-proto.mjs
nodes.summary: This script compiles Protocol Buffers into TypeScript and JavaScript code, generating service definitions and client implementations for gRPC and Nice-gRPC, while also setting up build prerequisites.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates cleanup, compilation, and generation of additional bridge and bus setup files.

nodes.name: compileProtos
nodes.summary: Compiles all .proto files into TypeScript service definitions and a descriptor set.

nodes.name: tsProtoc
nodes.summary: Runs protoc with ts-proto plugin to generate TypeScript files in specified output directory.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes previously generated files and directories to ensure clean state.

nodes.name: checkAppleSiliconCompatibility
nodes.summary: Checks if Rosetta 2 is installed on Apple Silicon macOS, aborting if not.

nodes.name: log_verbose
nodes.summary: Logs message only if verbose flag is set.

nodes.name: download-ripgrep.mjs
nodes.summary: Downloads and extracts ripgrep binaries for multiple platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows) from GitHub releases, storing them in a dist-standalone/ripgrep-binaries directory.

nodes.name: downloadFile
nodes.summary: Downloads a file from a given URL to a local path, handling redirects and cleaning up on error.

nodes.name: extractTarGz
nodes.summary: Extracts a tar.gz archive to a destination directory, stripping the top-level directory.

nodes.name: extractZip
nodes.summary: Extracts a zip archive using the unzip command, moving files from a subdirectory to the destination.

nodes.name: downloadRipgrepForPlatform
nodes.summary: Downloads, extracts, verifies, and cleans up ripgrep for a specific platform.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Downloads ripgrep binaries for all configured platforms and prints a summary of success/failure.

nodes.name: file-utils.mjs
nodes.summary: Provides asynchronous utility functions for file operations, including writing files with automatic directory creation and removing files/directories.

nodes.name: writeFileWithMkdirs
nodes.summary: Writes contents to a file, creating any missing parent directories.

nodes.name: rmrf
nodes.summary: Recursively removes a file or directory, ignoring if it doesn't exist.

nodes.name: rmdir
nodes.summary: Removes an empty directory, silently skipping if it doesn't exist or is not empty.

nodes.name: build-python-proto.mjs
nodes.summary: This script builds Python gRPC client code from proto files, including generating stubs, service wrappers, a connection manager, and a unified client class.

nodes.name: hasCommand
nodes.summary: Checks if a command is available on the system PATH.

nodes.name: resolvePython
nodes.summary: Resolves a usable Python interpreter, checking env var and common names.

nodes.name: checkGrpcTools
nodes.summary: Checks if grpc_tools Python package is installed.

nodes.name: ensureDir
nodes.summary: Creates a directory if it doesn't exist.

nodes.name: ensureInitPy
nodes.summary: Creates an empty __init__.py file in a directory if not present.

nodes.name: parseServicesWithFiles
nodes.summary: Parses proto files to extract service names, packages, and methods.

nodes.name: upperFirst
nodes.summary: Capitalizes the first character of a string.

nodes.name: generateConnectionPy
nodes.summary: Generates a connection manager module for gRPC channels.

nodes.name: generateClineClientPy
nodes.summary: Generates a unified client class that composes per-service wrappers.

nodes.name: generatePythonClient
nodes.summary: Orchestrates generation of the entire Python client package.

nodes.name: generatePyproject
nodes.summary: Generates a minimal pyproject.toml for the generated package.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Main entry point that orchestrates the complete build process.

nodes.name: generate-host-bridge-client.mjs
nodes.summary: Generates TypeScript client interfaces, external client implementations using nice-grpc, and VSCode handler config maps for host bridge services from a protobuf descriptor.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Loads host services from proto descriptor and generates three output files.

nodes.name: generateTypesFile
nodes.summary: Generates TypeScript client interface definitions for all host services.

nodes.name: generateClientInterfaceType
nodes.summary: Generates a single client interface for a given service with unary and streaming method signatures.

nodes.name: generateExternalClientFile
nodes.summary: Generates external client implementations using nice-grpc for all host services.

nodes.name: generateExternalClientSetup
nodes.summary: Generates a client implementation class for a single service that extends BaseGrpcClient.

nodes.name: generateVscodeClientFile
nodes.summary: Generates VSCode client setup with handler config map and service registries.

nodes.name: generateVscodeClientImplementation
nodes.summary: Generates service registry setup code for a single VSCode host service.

nodes.name: generate-stubs.js
nodes.summary: Generates JavaScript stubs for the VS Code API by parsing TypeScript type definitions and producing a runtime stub module.

nodes.name: traverse
nodes.summary: Recursively walks TypeScript AST statements and generates stub code for modules, functions, enums, variables, and classes.

nodes.name: mapReturn
nodes.summary: Maps a TypeScript return type string to a corresponding JavaScript stub return statement.

nodes.name: sanitizeParam
nodes.summary: Returns the parameter name or a default placeholder if the name is empty.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that reads the VS Code type definitions, generates stubs, and writes them to a file.
